scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source for local theorems with no Physlib physics counterpart. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors. They are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: solve_bte[bte_solver=direct_inverse] is the linear system Sum_{q'nu'} M_{q nu, q' nu'} F^alpha_{q' nu'} = c_{q nu} v^alpha_{q nu} over the modes (q, nu) of a finite Gamma-centred mesh. Its auxiliary formulas give M = C^(1/2) Omega~ C^(1/2) with C = diag(c), transcribed as lbteMatrix, and Chaput's Omega~ in the collision labeling q + q' + q'' = 0, transcribed as chaputCollision.

Omega~ has the Kronecker term 2 Gamma of the canonical linewidth Gamma = Im Sigma = 1/(2 tau), and a kernel enters every element, the diagonal included: (pi/(N_q hbar^2)) Sum_{nu''} |V_3|^2(q nu, q' nu', -q - q' nu'') 2 sqrt(n''(n'' + 1)) [delta(omega' - omega + omega'') + delta(omega' - omega - omega'') + delta(omega' + omega - omega'')]. The kernel |V_3|^2 and the linewidths Gamma are independent opaque inputs.
contract_kappa[bte_solver=direct_inverse] is kappa^{alpha beta} = Sum_{q nu} c v^alpha F^beta / (V_cell N_q).
boseRoot, channelSum, detailedBalanceLinewidth and collisionSquares are auxiliary definitions of the positivity proofs, not transcriptions of catalog formulas.
